candidates.change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so reentrant calls can change Put's balance accounting.
Change Put to not update unlockTime, so funds may be collectable earlier and affect subsequent Put behavior.
Change Put to not increase balance, so msg.value is accepted but balance stays unchanged.
Remove the require(!locked_) guard so modifier never reverts on reentrancy.
Replace `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` with `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime` to allow Collect at exact unlock time.
Remove `acc.balance>=MinSum` check so Collect succeeds even when balance is below MinSum.
Change `acc.balance>=_am` to `true` so any requested amount passes the check (DoS/overdraft guarded only by subtraction revert).
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am)` with assignment of a fixed zero value, so balance never decreases on successful collect.
Delete the subtraction line so balance is never updated after a successful collect call.
Delete the reentrancy guard lines so reentrant Collect calls can withdraw multiple times before balance updates.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation on Collect.
Delete the _s success check around the post-call balance update, so the balance is subtracted regardless of call success.
Replace the balance subtraction with the requested amount assignment, removing the MinSum precondition dependence.
Delete the require(!locked_) guard in nonReentrant_, allowing reentrant calls.
Delete the locked_ = true assignment in nonReentrant_.
Delete the locked_ = false assignment in nonReentrant_.
Weaken the condition on line 37 by removing the balance >= _am check, allowing Collect to attempt to withdraw more than the recorded balance.
Change the strict timestamp comparison on line 37 to allow collection when block.timestamp equals acc.unlockTime.
Change the minimum-sum comparison on line 37 from >= MinSum to > MinSum, rejecting the boundary case.
Change the balance-withdrawal comparison from >= _am to > _am, rejecting the exact-balance case.
Make the balance update depend on the failed-call flag by negating _s, so a successful ETH send results in reverted accounting semantics.
Skip subtraction by setting the caller's balance directly to _am instead of subtracting _am from the current balance.
Change the collection log value from _am to msg.value, altering the recorded message on a successful collect.
Move the balance subtraction into a private self-call reentrancy-relevant ordering so the state write no longer happens before the external call returns.
Remove the initial reentrancy lock check on line 12, so a previously locked state no longer rejects entry.
Set locked_ to false at the start of the modifier instead of true, defeating protection from reentrant calls.
Remove the unlock reset after the modified function body, leaving the contract permanently locked after the first protected call.
